**Finding: Compliant (preferred position).**

The agreement contains no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binding us. The license is expressly non-exclusive in both directions, the fee schedule has no minimum-volume or requirements commitment, and nothing prevents us from sourcing competing FX platform services. No redline proposed.

One note for the broader review, outside this rule: the Article XXII ROFR over a sale of our assets/merger (p0139) and the Article XX automatic termination on Change of Control absent Licensor consent (p0134) do constrain our corporate freedom, and are worth picking up under the assignment / change-of-control rule rather than here.
